Gatorland: the classic park.verification: Flickr page by William Warby (realname; username/pathAlias wwarby), titled 'Gatorland | Gatorland entrance, Florida...', taken 2002-04-22. Live page license checked directly on the Flickr page: license id 4 and a creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0 link, i.e. CC BY 2.0, matching Openverse's cached license. The photo shows Gatorland's giant alligator-mouth entrance building lettered 'GatOrland ORLANDO FL' across the lower jaw -- the park's iconic, one-of-a-kind roadside entrance -- proving the exact place beyond doubt. This is a different file than the guide's existing hero (Jawlene.jpg) and is not reused from any other pick in this guide. The structure is a long-standing unchanged fixture of the park (in place since the 1960s per the park's own history) so the 2002 date does not raise a currency concern.
